title: nettrace_3gpp_32_423: Split nettrace_msg_to_packet into sub-functions
description:
Extract two helper functions from the monolithic nettrace_msg_to_packet():

- nettrace_parse_msg_attributes(): handles extraction of function, name,
  and changeTime attributes from the <msg> XML element, including
  timestamp calculation.

- nettrace_build_epdu(): assembles the exported PDU buffer with all TLV
  tags (dissector name/table, IP addresses, ports, UE identity) and
  decodes the hex raw message content into binary packet data.

The orchestrator nettrace_msg_to_packet() is now ~80 lines with clear
flow: sanity checks, parse attributes, walk child elements, resolve
protocol via table lookup, and delegate buffer assembly.

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)
